kalshi_trades.pagination: cursor; each page is one cached request (cursor in the params)

bluesky.queries_note: first day shown; the same params repeat for every UTC day in the window

hourly.note: ts_utc is the candle end_period_ts; price forward-filled for hours with no trades

hourly_grid.note: every hour of the window; ts_utc is the hour's end (bucket start + 1 h), the same convention as the Kalshi candles. Null = no data for that hour.

daily.note: Kalshi daily: volume = sum of hourly candles by UTC date of end_period_ts, close = last close of the day. Hourly attention and trade series are summed by UTC date of the bucket start (null if any hour is missing); small_trade_share is small trades / all trades for the day. Attention values are never interpolated.

display_daily.note: Display series for charts only: one row per UTC date of the display window. The metrics, baselines, quality and series.daily use the analysis window and never read this block. Inside the analysis window the values are the series.daily values. Outside it each source is read from the raw cache, and dates no cached window covers are pulled as a new segment (see segments); each segment's daily values use the series.daily definitions on that segment's own pull: Kalshi close = last close of the UTC day by end_period_ts, volume = sum of the day's hourly candles (the first day of a segment has no candle ending at 00:00, the same as the first day of the analysis window); Wikipedia total = sum over the configured pages, null if any page is missing that day; news/<query>/<collection> = Media Cloud count-over-time count (matching stories) for that publish date. Null = no data, never interpolated or zero-filled.

sum_check.note: D close + R close per row where both are non-null. Two complementary contracts would sum to about 1; flag = abs(mean - 1) > 0.05. Nothing is dropped or adjusted.

opposing.rule: close = last R close of the UTC day by end_period_ts, volume = sum of the day's hourly R volume; null = no R candle that day

filled_hours.rule: no candle for that hour: price forward-filled from the previous hour, volume 0

forward_filled_null_price.rule: candle with a null price (its pull had no earlier close): price forward-filled from the previous hour, volume kept

null_price_hours.rule: no close known yet at that hour (no earlier candle with a price)

overlap_dropped.rule: segment candles at a ts the analysis run already has; the analysis value is kept

display_hourly.note: Hourly Kalshi for charts only: one row per hour of the display window, from display start 00:00 UTC to the market's last candle. ts_utc is the candle end_period_ts. Inside the analysis window the values are the series.hourly values; outside it they are read from the raw cache (see segments). An hour with no candle gets the previous hour's close and volume 0 (counted in filled_hours). An hour whose candle has a null price (that pull had no earlier close) gets the previous hour's close and keeps its volume (counted in forward_filled_null_price); series.hourly keeps the null. Only leading hours with no earlier close anywhere stay null (null_price_hours). Kalshi only: news and Wikipedia stay daily, never hourly. The metrics never read this block.

candles_after_grid.rule: R candles after the grid's last_ts are not added; the grid is not extended

leading_null_hours.rule: no R close known yet at that hour

filled_hours.rule: no R candle for that hour: R price forward-filled from the previous hour, R volume 0

forward_filled_null_price.rule: R candle with a null price: price forward-filled, volume kept

sum_check.note: D close + R close per row where both are non-null. Two complementary contracts would sum to about 1; flag = abs(mean - 1) > 0.05. Nothing is dropped or adjusted.

opposing.note: Republican contract of the same Kalshi event, for charts only. Read from the event's markets list (the market whose subtitle names the Republican party), not from a ticker pattern. Hourly candles for the display window from display start 00:00 UTC to end + 1 day 00:00 UTC, same chunks, cache and pacing as the Democratic contract. On the existing hourly grid: an hour with no R candle gets the previous hour's R close and R volume 0 (filled_hours); leading hours with no R close yet stay null (leading_null_hours). R candles past the grid's last_ts are not added. Daily R: close = last close of the UTC day by end_period_ts, volume = sum of the day's hourly volume. The metrics and the chart's volume series (kalshi/volume, Democratic) never read these columns.
